items.name: hbd-theme
items.title: Here Be Dragons Theme
items.description: The full HBD token system: primitive palette, semantic layer, spell-school accents, light/dark/high-contrast themes, and the Tailwind v4 @theme inline utilities. Ships the complete globals.css.

items.name: utils
items.title: cn utility
items.description: clsx + tailwind-merge class combiner used by every component.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: Indeterminate loading arc. Light-DOM SVG with a role=status announcement.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: HBD button: default/primary/gold variants, sm/md/lg sizes, icon-only, loading spinner overlay, and pressed (toggle) state. Brutalist offset shadow + sharp corners.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Decorative placeholder shape shown while real content loads. Light-DOM, aria-hidden; the surrounding container owns the aria-busy loading affordance. Variants: text, text-sm, text-lg, circle, rect (height required). Optional shimmer animation.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: HBD badge: count indicator (capped to "{max}+", default 99) or coloured status dot. Five colour variants (primary/success/warning/error/neutral). The visible count truncates but the accessible name reports the real count; dot variants carry role=status + aria-label only when a label is provided.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Circular avatar with two content branches: when imgSrc loads, generic person icon on absent/failed image. Sizes xs/sm/md/lg/xl/2xl. role=img + aria-label for a single SR-readable image.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.title: Aspect Ratio
items.description: Light-DOM layout wrapper that constrains its first child to a fixed aspect ratio via the native CSS aspect-ratio property. Accepts colon (16:9), slash (16/9), or decimal (1.777) notation.

items.name: divider
items.title: Divider
items.description: Light-DOM separator: horizontal/vertical rules, subtle/strong/gold colours, solid/dashed/double styles, plus labelled and ornamental (decorative sigil) variants. role=separator with aria-orientation; ornamental is aria-hidden.
items.verdict: fixed: divider item was missing from registry.json (could not be installed); added it matching the canonical hand-ported CSS-paired item shape. The divider.tsx and divider.css port files were already faithful to source.

items.name: spacer
items.title: Spacer
items.description: Explicit-whitespace layout utility. Decorative light-DOM element (role=none aria-hidden) whose width/height are written inline from size + axis.
items.verdict: fixed: restored the source's axis .toLowerCase() normalization that the port dropped (non-lowercase axis values now resolve like the WC instead of silently falling back to vertical)

items.name: portal
items.title: Portal
items.description: Relocates its children into a target element elsewhere in the document (default body), via ReactDOM.createPortal. Supports prepend to insert at the start of the target. Light DOM, no styles — cascade reaches the moved nodes from the target's ancestry, mirroring the hbd-portal web component.
items.verdict: fixed: portal was missing from registry.json; added the registry item (no-CSS Light-DOM component, empty dependencies, @hbd/hbd-theme registryDependency). The portal.tsx port itself was already faithful — no code changes needed.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: Light-DOM progress bar with three modes: determinate (sized fill + ARIA value), indeterminate (animated shimmer), and segmented (N filled cells of M). default/success/warning/error variants, sm/md/lg sizes, optional label, value readout, and striped overlay.
items.verdict: fixed: progress item was missing from registry.json (port files existed but were never registered, so shadcn add could not install it) — added the item with cva in dependencies. TSX/CSS/ARIA were already faithful.

items.name: chip
items.title: Chip
items.description: Labelled pill with optional leading icon, removable (✕) button, and selectable toggle behaviour. primary/success/warning/error/neutral variants, sm/md/lg sizes, outline modifier, and selected (aria-pressed) state. Cancelable onToggle/onRemove callbacks.

items.name: codeblock
items.title: Codeblock
items.description: Display-only dark code surface with optional filename/language header, line-number gutter, and copy-to-clipboard button.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty State
items.description: Empty-state templates that fill the space where content would appear and communicate why it is absent and what to do next. 13 canonical templates (no-data, no-results, error/offline, error-4xx/5xx/network/form, success-*) with size, inline, and semantic error/success tint variants. Hand-ported light-DOM, no Radix.

items.name: full-banner
items.title: Full-Page Banner
items.description: Light-DOM full-screen takeover that fills the viewport with a single dominant message. Ten templates (maintenance/launch/restricted/offline + error-404/500/403 + success-submitted/completed/welcome) with bespoke inline illustrations, optional dark inverted scheme, and a configurable semantic heading level (h1/h2/h3). error-*/success-* keys add a status-tinted eyebrow + illustration while meaning stays in text. Slots: children -> actions row, meta prop -> meta line.

items.name: spell-card
items.title: Spell Card
items.description: Light-DOM presentational card for a D&D spell: school colour band, ornamental gold corners, level/cantrip badge, school eyebrow, name heading, ritual/concentration tags, a casting-time/range/components/duration meta grid (dl/dt/dd), italic description, optional "At Higher Levels" and footer zones. Eight spell-school colour modifiers. role=article with an aria-label woven from the spell name; tabbable with a focus-visible ring.

items.name: stat-block
items.title: Stat Block
items.description: Light-DOM D&D 5e creature/NPC stat block: name + subtitle header, basic stats (AC/HP/Speed), a six-ability score table with modifiers, property rows (saving throws/skills/immunities/senses/languages/CR), and trait/action/reaction/legendary-action sections. role=article with aria-label; legendary and compact density modifiers. Purely presentational.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: HBD canonical form field: label + input + hint/error/success + live char-count + prefix/suffix + password eye toggle. Owns the shared .hbd-field chrome (and the form-validation helpers) that textarea, otp-input, select trigger, stepper, and combobox reuse. sm/md/lg sizes, error/success/disabled/readonly states, aria-invalid + aria-describedby wiring, controlled-first value.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Multiline form field reusing the shared .hbd-field chrome (label + input-wrapper + footer): native <textarea> with optional auto-resize (height from scrollHeight), manual vertical resize, hint/error/success footer messages, and a tri-state character counter (default -> warning at >=80% -> over at >=100% of maxLength). sm/md/lg sizes; error/success/disabled/readonly state modifiers. Controlled-first (value + onValueChange) with uncontrolled defaultValue fallback. hbd:input -> onInput and hbd:change -> onChange callbacks receive { value, name }. aria-describedby wires hint/error/success/count ids; aria-invalid + role=alert/status on messages.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: HBD checkbox: native <input type=checkbox> visually hidden (clip technique) behind a CSS-drawn .hbd-checkbox__control box with a brutalist offset shadow (--hbd-checkbox-shadow*). Controlled-first (checked + onCheckedChange, defaultChecked uncontrolled fallback) with checked, indeterminate (mixed dash), disabled, and error states. Carries the WC ARIA exactly: aria-describedby links hint + error spans, aria-invalid/aria-required on the input, role=alert on the error message.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: Binary on/off control with immediate-effect semantics. A visually-hidden native input[role=switch] carries focus, keyboard activation (Space toggles) and form value; a presentational pill track + sliding thumb provide the visuals. sm/md/lg sizes (token-driven), left/right label position, optional hint, and error state with aria-invalid + aria-describedby wiring. Controlled-first via checked + onCheckedChange (detail {checked, value}), with defaultChecked uncontrolled fallback.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: HBD radio group: a real <fieldset>/<legend> radiogroup built on Radix RadioGroup with the legacy .hbd-* BEM classes re-applied. Roving-tabindex keyboard model (ArrowUp/Down/Left/Right move + select, Home/End), vertical or horizontal orientation, per-option label + hint, and field error wiring (aria-invalid/aria-describedby/role=alert). Controlled value + onValueChange (legacy { value, name } detail), optional defaultValue, and items[] prop or <RadioGroup.Item> children.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: HBD slider: single-handle or two-handle range, sm/md/lg sizes, optional value readout, tick marks, and hint/error footer. Re-based on @radix-ui/react-slider with the legacy .hbd-slider* classes re-applied to Track/Range/Thumb; controlled value (number | [low, high]) + onValueChange, plus onValueCommit. Full Arrow/Home/End/PageUp/PageDown keyboard support and per-thumb accessible names with aria-invalid/aria-describedby error wiring.

items.name: otp-input
items.title: OTP Input
items.description: One-time-password / verification-code input: a row of single-character cells that auto-advance on entry, accept clipboard paste (spread across cells), and support arrow/backspace/Home/End navigation. 4 or 6 cells; numeric or alphanumeric; optional inline separator (length 6). Controlled-first value + onValueChange + onComplete, with label/hint/error field chrome and aria-invalid/aria-describedby wiring.

items.name: file-upload
items.title: File Upload
items.description: Hand-ported light-DOM dropzone (role=button, click-to-browse + HTML5 drag-and-drop) with single/multiple files, MIME/extension accept, max-size, max-files, per-file progress bars, image thumbnails via FileReader, and per-file/field error states. Drag-over halo via .hbd-file-upload--drag-over; per-file is-uploading/is-complete/is-error states. Reuses the shared .hbd-field label/hint/error/footer chrome from input. Controlled-first (files + onFilesChange, defaultFiles uncontrolled fallback) with an imperative getFiles/setProgress/setFileError ref handle. hbd:files-added -> onChange, hbd:file-removed -> onRemove, hbd:rejected -> onRejected.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: HBD toggle group: a row (or column) of joined toggle buttons. Single mode is radio-like (role=radiogroup, one-of-N, roving tabindex, arrows move+select); multi mode is independent on/off (role=group, aria-pressed). Controlled value(s) + onValueChange. Composes the HBD Button.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: Standalone system-level feedback banner: form errors, system notices, API responses. info/success/warning/error variants each map to a role + aria-live (error: alert/assertive, success+warning: status/polite, info: note/no aria-live) carried on the host. alert/banner/inline layout types, optional bold title (wires aria-labelledby), and a dismissible × button that animates max-height+opacity collapse then fires onDismiss({variant,type}) and unmounts. persist remembers dismissed state in localStorage under 'hbd-alert-dismissed-<id|uid>'. Exposes an imperative dismiss(); action buttons via Alert.Action carry .hbd-alert__action. Hand-ported light-DOM, no Radix.

items.name: callout
items.title: Callout
items.description: HBD status callout: info / warning / error / success saturated surfaces plus the HBD-specific "sage-advice" advisory variant (pale-gold dashed accent, serif-italic body). Optional bold title (wires aria-labelledby) and a dismissible button whose collapse animation (opacity + max-height + padding + margin on --hbd-duration-slow) fires onDismiss once before unmount. Variant drives role: note (info/success/sage-advice), status (warning), alert (error).

items.name: breadcrumbs
items.title: Breadcrumbs
items.description: WAI-ARIA 1.2 breadcrumb trail (nav > ol > li) with a decorative › separator, aria-current=page on the final crumb, and an optional truncate threshold that collapses the middle crumbs behind an ellipsis button (fires hbd:expand). Dual API: compound Breadcrumbs + Breadcrumbs.Item, or a data-driven items[] prop.

items.name: avatar-group
items.title: Avatar Group
items.description: Composes Avatar children into an overlapping stack: renders the first `max` (default 5) and appends a "+N" overflow bubble for the rest. `size` propagates to every child and drives the bubble size. Host is role=group with a default aria-label reporting the TOTAL count ("N participants"); the overflow bubble is role=img aria-label "N more".

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Compound card surface grouping related content and optional actions. Four layouts (basic / interactive / media / horizontal), three surface modifiers (default shadow / bordered / elevated), and slotted sub-parts (Media, Header, Title, Body, Footer, Badge). Interactive cards render as a focusable role=button div or, with href, an inner native anchor.

items.name: list
items.title: List
items.description: HBD compound List + List.Item: static / href (<a>) / selectable (<button>) items with leading, primary, secondary, trailing, and hover-revealed action slots. Cancelable onSelect (return false to veto), selected indicator + aria-current, sm/md/lg, divided/bordered/flush variants.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Hand-ported (no Radix) vertically-stacked expand/collapse panels. Compound Accordion + Accordion.Item API; single (default, one-open) or multi (independent) expand; controlled value/values + onValueChange with uncontrolled defaultValue/defaultValues; heading-level 2|3|4. Real <button> trigger with aria-expanded/aria-controls, role=region panel with aria-labelledby; roving ArrowUp/ArrowDown + Home/End keyboard nav skipping disabled; CSS-only max-height open animation driven by .hbd-accordion__item--open. onOpen/onClose carry { index, title }.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: HBD tabs: a role=tablist navigation built on Radix Tabs with the legacy .hbd-* BEM classes re-applied to Root/List/Trigger/Content (className + asChild) so the de-shadowed tabs.css renders 1:1, including the active 'ribbon' indicator (.hbd-tabs__tab::before driven by --hbd-tabs-indicator-*). Horizontal/vertical orientation, roving-tabindex keyboard (arrows follow orientation, Home/End), aria-selected/controls/labelledby, lazy (Radix unmount) or eager (forceMount) panel mode, optional count badge, and a scrollable overflow variant with JS scroll-prev/next buttons + scroll-into-view. Controlled-first via value + onValueChange (legacy hbd:change { value } detail), with defaultValue uncontrolled fallback. Compound members TabsList / TabsTrigger / TabsContent (+ optional TabsPanels).

items.name: stepper-nav
items.title: Stepper Nav
items.description: Step-progress navigation: a horizontal or vertical row/column of numbered step indicators joined by connectors. Each step's status is active (the current index), completed (before it), upcoming (after it), or an explicit error override. Renders a real <nav>/<ol> landmark with aria-current=step; SR-only Completed:/Error: prefixes carry progress without colour. Controlled-first activeStep + onStepChange (legacy hbd:change { step, label }) with defaultActiveStep fallback. Non-linear mode renders completed/error indicators as real <button>s that move the active step on click. Compound <StepperNav> + <StepperNav.Step> or a data-driven steps[] prop.

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: HBD numeric +/- stepper: a native number input flanked by decrement (−) and increment (+) buttons, wrapped in the shared .hbd-field chrome (label + hint + error). Controlled-first value + onValueChange (string), min/max/step, sm/md/lg sizes, error/disabled states. Keyboard: the input is the sole Tab stop (buttons are tabIndex=-1); ArrowUp/Down = ±step, PageUp/Down = ±10·step, Home = min, End = max. A `thin` prop collapses the field to its intrinsic width for inline / table-cell use. Reuses @hbd/input's .hbd-field field chrome.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: HBD data table: real <table role=grid> with sortable headers (hbd:sort -> onSort with {key,direction} + aria-sort ascending/descending/none), optional row selection via a leading checkbox column (select-all + per-row, hbd:selection-change -> onSelectionChange with {selected}), three row-height sizes (sm/md/lg), striped/bordered variants, sticky header and sticky first column. Data is driven by the columns + rows props (the WC's JS-property API). Sorting + selection are controlled-first (sortKey/sortDir + onSort, selected + onSelectionChange) with uncontrolled fallbacks (defaultSortKey/defaultSortDir/defaultSelected). Carries the WC ARIA verbatim: role=grid/row/columnheader/gridcell, aria-rowcount/colcount, aria-rowindex, aria-selected, aria-multiselectable, plus the full roving-tabindex grid keyboard pattern (arrows/Home/End, Enter/Space to sort).

items.name: skeleton-group
items.title: Skeleton Group
items.description: Preset skeleton layouts that arrange multiple Skeleton shapes into recognisable loading patterns: avatar-text (default), card, list-item, table-row. Light-DOM, decorative; the group is aria-hidden while the surrounding container owns aria-busy. Widths cycle deterministically (no Math.random). noShimmer cascades to every child skeleton. Composes the Skeleton primitive.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: HBD tooltip: a floating label shown on hover (after the --hbd-tooltip-delay-show delay) / focus (instant), built on Radix Tooltip with the legacy .hbd-* BEM classes re-applied to the Content panel (className via asChild) so the de-shadowed tooltip.css renders 1:1, including the CSS-triangle arrow (.hbd-tooltip__arrow driven by --hbd-tooltip-arrow-size) and placement top|bottom|left|right with collision flip + shift (the WC's opposite-side flip + viewport clamp). role=tooltip on the panel with aria-describedby wired trigger->panel; aria-live=off; Escape + pointer-down dismiss keeping trigger focus. Token-driven show delay via the --hbd-tooltip-delay-show token (overridable with the legacy `delay` prop); a `content` convenience prop or compound Tooltip.Trigger / Tooltip.Content members. Controlled-first overlay via open + onOpenChange + defaultOpen.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: HBD popover: a click-triggered, non-modal (aria-modal="false", no backdrop/scroll-lock) floating panel built on Radix Popover, with the legacy .hbd-popover* BEM classes re-applied to the Radix parts so the de-shadowed popover.css renders 1:1. Compound Popover + Popover.Trigger (asChild) / Popover.Content / Popover.Close. Content renders the optional title header (with an icon-only ✕ Button), body (children), optional footer prop, and a CSS-triangle arrow that tracks the resolved data-side after collision flip. placement (top/bottom default/left/right) + offset flow via context (default 8). Escape + outside-pointerdown dismissal, focus trap + focus return, and aria-haspopup/expanded/controls wiring all come from Radix. Controlled-first: open + onOpenChange + defaultOpen, plus onOpen/onClose bridging the WC's hbd:open/hbd:close events.

items.name: dropdown
items.title: Dropdown
items.description: Trigger button + action menu panel using ARIA menu/menuitem semantics. Owns the shared menu primitives (Dropdown.Item / Dropdown.Separator / Dropdown.Group) reused by context-menu and split-button. Roving tabindex, Arrow/Home/End + first-character typeahead, Enter/Space activation, Escape, Tab dismissal, outside-click, and viewport-flip placement, ported 1:1 from hbd-dropdown.js + menu-controller.js.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: Right-click (and touch long-press) menu that reuses the shared menu panel/items + menu.css owned by @hbd/dropdown. onContextMenu (mouse/pen) and a 500ms touch long-press (8px move tolerance) open a position:fixed panel at the cursor with viewport-edge flipping (clamp x/y on-screen). Reuses Dropdown.Item / Dropdown.Separator / Dropdown.Group as compound members, rebuilding them into role=menuitem rows with roving tabindex, Arrow/Home/End + first-character typeahead, Enter/Space activation, and the .is-focused state. Escape / click-outside / window-resize close; focus returns to the right-clicked host. hbd:select -> onSelect({ value, label }); onOpenChange notifies open/close. Owns NO CSS — the only shell rule (.hbd-context-menu { display: contents }) lives in the dropdown-owned menu.css.

items.name: split-button
items.title: Split Button
items.description: Two HBD buttons joined into one visual unit: a wide primary ACTION half on the left and a narrow CHEVRON TRIGGER on the right. Clicking the action fires onAction; clicking the chevron opens a hand-ported dropdown menu of alternative actions (SplitButton.Item children or an items[] prop). The panel is an absolutely-positioned descendant so the legacy .hbd-split-button--open .hbd-split-button__panel rule drives the opacity/transform transition AND the chevron rotation 1:1. Controlled-first open + onOpenChange with defaultOpen fallback, roving menu keyboard nav (Escape/Tab/Enter/Space/Arrow/Home/End), capture-phase outside-click, and focus return to the trigger. Menu rows reuse the .hbd-field__option chrome. variant (default/primary/gold), size (sm/md/lg), disabled. role=menu/menuitem with aria-haspopup/expanded/controls/label.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Fully-accessible custom select (combobox + listbox) on the shared .hbd-field chrome. Owns the option/group model (Select.Option + Select.Group). Controlled value + onValueChange + defaultValue, hidden native <select> form fallback, keyboard typeahead/Arrow/Home/End/Escape, click-outside, and fixed-coordinate panel positioning that escapes scrolling/transformed ancestors.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: HBD combobox / autocomplete: a filterable text input + listbox suggestion panel following the APG aria-activedescendant pattern (DOM focus STAYS on the input). Three modes — autocomplete (free text), strict (must match a listed option, reverts on blur), multi (in-field removable chips). Debounced filtering, no-filter server-search mode (onSearch) with a loading spinner, imperative setOptions() for async data, controlled-first value+onValueChange (single) / values+onValuesChange (multi) with uncontrolled defaultValue/defaultValues fallbacks. Keyboard: ArrowUp/Down/Home/End move the active option, Enter selects, Escape closes+reverts, Tab closes, Backspace removes the last chip in multi mode. Authors options declaratively with Combobox.Option / Combobox.Group (re-exported from @hbd/select). Panel anchored with @floating-ui/react (fixed strategy). Reuses @hbd/input's .hbd-field chrome and @hbd/select's .hbd-field__select-panel / .hbd-field__option styles.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Page-navigation control: numbered pages with prev/next + ellipsis (full), a 'Page N of M' live label (compact), or arrow-only prev/next (simple). The host element IS the <nav> landmark (role=navigation + aria-label=Pagination), exactly like the Light-DOM WC. Button mode fires hbd:change -> onChange/onPageChange and updates the controlled `page`; link mode renders <a href> from `hrefPrefix` with the current page as a <span aria-current=page>. Optional first/last jump buttons, a 'Showing X-Y of Z' info readout, a 'Page [input] Go' goto cluster (Enter or click submits), and a page-size <select> built from @hbd/select whose change resets the page to 1 and fires hbd:page-size-change -> onPageSizeChange. Boundary prev/next stay focusable with aria-disabled=true. Controlled-first: page + onPageChange + defaultPage uncontrolled fallback.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: HBD sliding overlay panel: four placements (left/right/top/bottom) with wide (L/R) and tall (T/B) size modifiers, token-backed widths/heights. Portal + focus-trap + scroll-lock + return-focus + Escape + backdrop-click via Radix Dialog, with .hbd-drawer* classes re-applied so the de-shadowed drawer.css renders 1:1. Controlled open + onOpenChange + defaultOpen; onOpen/onClose bridge the WC hbd:open/hbd:close events. no-backdrop sidebar mode and no-close non-dismissible mode.

items.name: modal
items.title: Modal
items.description: HBD modal: a centred overlay dialog HAND-PORTED from hbd-modal.js (no Radix) so the .is-open / .is-closing transitionend close lifecycle is preserved 1:1 — close() applies .is-closing, keeps it until the dialog's opacity transitionend, THEN releases scroll-lock + restores focus + fires onClose. Portals a backdrop / container / dialog tree into document.body with EVERY legacy .hbd-modal* BEM class re-applied (role=dialog/alertdialog, aria-modal, aria-labelledby). Reproduces focus-trap across Light DOM + open shadow roots, body-scroll-lock (shared counter), return-focus, an always-available Escape exit (even with noClose, SC 2.1.2), backdrop / container click-to-dismiss (noBackdropClose opt-out), host-level [data-modal-close] delegation, stacked z via --hbd-z-modal/--hbd-z-overlay, and an alertdialog sub-type that focuses its first (cancel) footer button on open. Sizes sm/md(default)/lg/full map --hbd-modal-width-*. Controlled-first overlay: open + onOpenChange + defaultOpen, plus onOpen/onClose bridging the WC's hbd:open/hbd:close. Compound Modal + Modal.Footer (slot=footer) / Modal.Close ([data-modal-close]). Pairs with the de-shadowed modal.css.

items.name: navbar
items.title: Navbar
items.description: Primary top navigation bar (role=banner) with a centred desktop nav and a full-viewport off-canvas mobile menu below --hbd-navbar-mobile-breakpoint (768px). The hamburger toggle carries aria-expanded/aria-controls; the mobile menu is a role=dialog aria-modal panel portalled to document.body and behaves exactly like <hbd-drawer>: ref-counted scroll-lock, focus-trap (Tab/Shift+Tab cycling), return-focus, Escape-to-close, and auto-close when a debounced resize crosses back above the breakpoint (token read off the host). Links auto-mark .is-active + aria-current=page on pathname match. Compound API: Navbar + Navbar.Logo / Navbar.Link / Navbar.Actions, mirrored into both the desktop row and the mobile menu. Variants: sticky / transparent / bordered. Controlled-first open + onOpenChange with defaultOpen fallback, plus onOpen/onClose (the WC's hbd:open / hbd:close).

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: HBD imperative toast/snackbar system ported from the hbd-toast web component. A <ToastProvider> renders the singleton portal region (role=region, aria-label=Notifications, aria-live=polite flipped to assertive for one macrotask on error toasts, aria-relevant=additions) at the viewport edge; a useToast() hook AND a standalone toast() callable (plus toast.info/success/warning/error/show/setPosition) drive a shared module-level store so notifications can be fired without React context. Reproduces the WC 1:1: show({ message, title, variant, duration, action, dismissible }); variants info(default)/success/warning/error with per-variant role (error->alert, else status); auto-dismiss timer (default 5000ms = --hbd-duration-linger) with hover-pause + focus-pause + focus-out-resume and a countdown progress bar whose animation-duration matches and pauses with the timer; prefers-reduced-motion AND Infinity duration disable the timer + drop the progress bar (SC 2.2.1); MAX_STACK=3 active cap with an overflow queue that dequeues on dismiss; enter/leave lifecycle via .is-entering/.is-leaving where the leave animationend fires onDismiss({variant}) (the WC's hbd:dismiss) then removes the toast; setPosition(top-right default | top-center | bottom-right | bottom-center | bottom-left) re-classes the container to swap the directional slide keyframe. The de-shadowed toast.css carries every --hbd-* token and ALL NINE @keyframes verbatim; the inline animation-duration is the documented per-instance value-driven style exception.

items.name: time-picker
items.title: Time Picker
items.description: Keyboard-accessible time picker with scrollable hour / minute / (AM·PM) columns, click-to-type header, and a dropdown-style slide panel. Controlled value + onValueChange + defaultValue.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date Picker
items.description: HBD date picker: a click-triggered calendar popover on the shared .hbd-field chrome (@hbd/input) plus a Radix-portalled non-modal (aria-modal="false", no backdrop/scroll-lock) panel. The panel holds a month header (prev/next nav + Intl month-year label), a weekday columnheader row, and a 6×7 APG grid (role="grid" / role="gridcell" + aria-selected + aria-current="date" + per-cell aria-label, roving tabindex, full keyboard date nav: Arrow/Home/End/PageUp/PageDown±Shift-year, Enter/Space select, Escape close), then a Today/Clear/Cancel/Confirm footer. Three variants: "date" (single), "date-time" (single + an embedded TimePicker, payload YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM), "date-range" (start/end with hover-preview). Committed-vs-pending model: opening snapshots saved→pending; cell clicks / Today / Clear mutate pending only and keep the panel open; Confirm commits (fires onValueChange/onRangeChange/onChange) + returns focus; Cancel and Escape discard + return focus; outside-pointerdown discards without returning focus. Radix Popover supplies portal + focus-trap + Escape/outside dismissal + return-focus; the legacy .hbd-date-picker* BEM classes are re-applied to the Radix parts so the de-shadowed date-picker.css renders 1:1. Native Intl.DateTimeFormat drives month/weekday/cell-label text; plain Date arithmetic drives nav (no date library). Controlled-first: value+defaultValue (single/date-time), valueStart/valueEnd+defaultValueStart/defaultValueEnd (range), open+defaultOpen+onOpenChange, plus onOpen/onClose bridging the WC's hbd:open/hbd:close.
